note: Cadence and targeting for the Instagram route. Edit this file, not the code. Owner's instruction of 20 Oct 2026, until changed: Master articles only, five posts a day, in a mix of 2 evergreen and 3 trending. No digest post while targets is masters_only. Five a day sits far inside the account's own publishing cap, which the route reads from Instagram before every write and stops two short of.

rules.images: the article's own licensed photograph at a public JPEG URL; no upload, no substitution, no Gemini or generated picture
rules.eligibility: only an article this repository can prove is live
rules.quota: read content_publishing_limit before every write and stop two short of it
rules.dedupe: one post per article URL, forever, recorded in instagram_tracker.json
rules.identity: byline Kushal Daga · publication Daily Yield · legal name Kushal Kumar Daga
rules.mix: the day is built as 2 evergreen + 3 trending, alternating with trending first; if one pool runs short the rest of the allowance is filled from what is live and not yet posted, and the run records mix.relaxed
rules.targeting: Master articles only for now - no morning digest, no news-only post. The digest builder stays available by setting targets back to masters_plus_digest
